steps.description:
1. A large pool of water features a corpse which is drowned in the middle of the lake.
2. You have to **jump on it**, and another human mindlessly plunges into the water, providing you a second platform to jump across, which is that human.
3. After reaching to the other side, you have to **drag one of the bodies**.
4. You will then reach to a crushing trap, so **release the body to the pit**, then proceed forward.
